messages:
zoe_cs: quick heads up 10: NimbusEdge (NE-204) renewal landed. Procurement sent PO requesting 9mo term (vs 12), Net-60, and billing split between NimbusEdge UK / NimbusEdge FR. they also want customer-managed KMS and to keep onboarding in May. need legal + finance to confirm single-signature SOW + split invoice flow.

marco_sa: PO attached? i can help chase their procurement contact if VAT docs are missing. also flag: they've previously asked for a vendor credit hold if billing delays >2 weeks.

zoe_cs: PO: NE-PO-2026-3344. snippet: ```PO: NE-PO-2026-3344
Amount: $108,000 (split 50/50 UK/FR)
Term: 9 months
Billing: Net 60
KMS: customer-managed (ARN provided)```

hana_fin: finance note: Net-60 acceptable after credit check. we need a validated French VAT cert that matches PO legal name before issuing FR invoice. we prefer separate invoice numbers for reconciliation. if they provide attestation that's fine.

felix_legal: high level: single SOW signed by NimbusEdge UK is doable if we include an addendum that documents invoice split and assigns tax responsibilities. will draft addendum language with indemnity for FR-specific taxes. if customer insists on a single-entity liability we may need FR signature.

lina_enable: enablement flagged for week-of-5/23. if billing isn't cleared by 5/16 we might need to push training one week. i'll prep the acceptance checklist so finance has evidence for go-live.

marco_sa: pinged procurement for updated VAT cert + signed vendor attestation. asked them to confirm who on their side has authority to sign for FR entity. also asked whether they accept addendum-only flow.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 'NimbusEdge_SOW_Addendum_v1' ready to be attached. Waiting on 'Addendum_Invoices_KMS' file.

hana_fin: we can issue UK invoice once addendum is countersigned. FR invoice on hold until VAT legal name validated. marking account health: yellow (moderate risk due to Net-60 + split billing).

felix_legal: addendum draft completed: includes invoice split clause, KMS onboarding responsibilities (customer supplies ARN + test window), acceptance criteria, and FR tax indemnity. uploading to DocuSign as soon as zoe signs off.

zoe_cs: sent addendum to procurement and asked them to return signed vendor attestation + VAT cert by Thu noon. noted their price lock ends at month-end so timebox is tight. i'll escalate to AM if no docs by Thu.

marco_sa: procurement replied with FR VAT cert and a signed attestation confirming FR entity will not sign but accepts invoicing. forwarding to finance.

hana_fin: received VAT cert and attestation. vendor mapping updated. we can generate FR invoice once addendum is countersigned. removing hold on UK invoice provisioning.

felix_legal: uploaded addendum to DocuSign and sent envelope to customer primary signee.

 docusign-bot: Envelope 'NimbusEdge_SOW_Addendum_v1' sent to primary signee.

zoe_cs: good progress 14. i'll monitor the envelope and hand off to AR + enablement once countersigned. keeping thread open until both invoices posted. :white_check_mark:
